entries.name: Bruce Dancis

expected.charges: Mutilation of a Selective Service registration certificate (tore up his draft card at Cornell, December 14, 1966).
expected.sentence: Served about 19 months in federal prison, entering in May 1969.

entries.rationale: Dancis dated his surrender and initial county-jail confinement May 20, 1969 in his July 1971 first-person account. Lew Zipin, a contemporary fellow activist reviewing the memoir, explicitly gives May 20, 1969 through December 23, 1970. The memoir chapter abstract also identifies December 23 parole, although its later December 3 wording appears inconsistent. Preserve the separate November 1968 week of custody as unresolved rather than extending continuous custody through bail.
